title: OpenAI flew influencers to a nature resort to fix its image. The internet called it greenwashing.
excerpt: OpenAI flew influencers to a $2,000-a-night wellness resort to warm up the mood around AI. The internet called it greenwashing, and the creators took the hit.
content_html:
OpenAI has an image problem, and it just spent a weekend making it worse. The company flew a group of influencers to a luxury resort to soften how the public sees AI. The internet took one look and called it greenwashing.

The event, branded “Summer Camp,” ran at Wildflower Farms, a resort in New York’s Hudson Valley where rooms can top $2,000 a night, Business Insider reported. Creators posted farm-to-table dinners under bistro lights, a beekeeping session, and classes on OpenAI’s tools. They went home with branded canvas bags and jars of honey.

The videos were soft-focus and lighthearted. The comments were not. Across TikTok, Reddit, X and Instagram, people called the trip “dystopian” and accused OpenAI of greenwashing. One commenter told TechCrunch the issue was timing: “The world is on fire. It’s not a great time to brag about your $5,000-a-night suite.”

The irony writes itself

The charge is not abstract. OpenAI is building data centres across the US at speed, and those sites are hungry for energy and water. The company is reported to be close to a $500bn deal for a data centre in Ohio. Hosting a nature retreat, bees included, in the middle of that was never going to read as innocent.

It also landed in a public already wary of AI. Worry about power bills, water and job losses has hardened into open hostility online. The creators became the nearest target. Taylor Lorenz said the internet was “cancelling” attendees. Some doubled down; one insisted her “morals were not compromised.” Another relabelled the trip as time with “a tech company,” then deleted the OpenAI video.

Everyone does it. OpenAI got caught.

Influencer trips are standard, and OpenAI is not the only lab running them. Rival Anthropic reportedly hosted a low-key creator dinner for Claude, and Microsoft took influencers to the Super Bowl. Neither drew this. The difference, one startup noted, was visibility. Anthropic kept its version subtle. OpenAI staged the whole thing in the open, logo glowing at the end of the table.

None of it was accidental. OpenAI hired Instagram’s former partnerships chief, its “celebrity whisperer,” as its first head of creative partnerships this year. Summer Camp, it says, was education-led, timed to the launch of ChatGPT Work, and meant to show people practical uses of its tools. “Creators are an important part of our community,” a spokesperson said, adding that the company welcomes “healthy debate.”

The debate is the part OpenAI seems to have misjudged. It would not say whether the creators were paid, or expected to post. What the weekend bought was a fresh wave of the exact sentiment it set out to cool. The image problem was the reason for the trip. The trip became the image problem.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 有一个图像问题，仅仅花了一个周末就让情况变得更糟。 该公司派了一群有影响力的人士飞往豪华度假村，以软化公众对人工智能的看法。 互联网一看，称其为“绿色清洗”。

据《商业内幕》报道，这场名为“夏令营”的活动在纽约哈德逊河谷的度假胜地野花农场举行，那里的客房每晚价格最高可达 2000 美元。 创作者发布了小酒馆灯光下的从农场到餐桌的晚餐、养蜂课程以及 OpenAI 工具课程。 他们带着品牌帆布袋和蜂蜜罐回家。

这些视频焦点柔和且轻松愉快。 评论没有。 在 TikTok、Reddit、X 和 Instagram 上，人们称这次旅行为“反乌托邦”，并指责 OpenAI 进行绿色清洗。 一位评论者告诉 TechCrunch，这个问题是时机问题：“世界着火了。 现在可不是吹嘘你每晚 5,000 美元套房的好时机。”

讽刺本身就在写

这项指控并不抽象。 OpenAI 正在美国各地快速建设数据中心，而这些站点都需要能源和水。 据报道，该公司即将达成价值 5000 亿美元的俄亥俄州数据中心交易。 在其中举办一场自然静修活动，包括蜜蜂在内，永远不会被认为是无辜的。

它还引起了公众对人工智能的警惕。 对电费、水费和失业的担忧已经在网上演变成公开的敌意。 创作者成为最近的目标。 泰勒·洛伦兹表示，互联网正在“取消”与会者。 有些人加倍努力；有些人则加倍努力。一位坚称她的“道德没有受到损害”。 另一位将这次旅行重新标记为“一家科技公司”，然后删除了 OpenAI 视频。

每个人都这样做。 OpenAI 被抓住了。

有影响力的旅行是标准的，OpenAI 并不是唯一运行这种旅行的实验室。 据报道，竞争对手 Anthropic 为克劳德举办了一场低调的创作者晚宴，而微软则邀请有影响力的人观看超级碗比赛。 这个都没有画。 一家初创公司指出，区别在于可见性。 Anthropic 的版本保持微妙。 OpenAI 将整个过程公开进行，标志在桌子的末端闪闪发光。

这一切都不是偶然的。 OpenAI 聘请了 Instagram 的前合作伙伴主管、其“名人耳语者”作为今年第一位创意合作伙伴主管。 据称，夏令营以教育为主导，与 ChatGPT Work 的推出同步，旨在向人们展示其工具的实际用途。 “创作者是我们社区的重要组成部分，”一位发言人表示，并补充说公司欢迎“健康的辩论”。

这场争论是 OpenAI 似乎误判的部分。 它没有透露创作者是否获得报酬，或预计他们会发帖。 周末带来的却是一波新的情绪浪潮，而这种情绪正是即将降温的情绪。 形象问题是这次旅行的原因。 这次旅行成了形象问题。
